subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.----INFO.DY.
description: Diagram opening MP(I)-27 — the section examining how by-the-end-of-the-sixties everyone-had-rediscovered-Marx in the so-called black revolution. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'by the end of the sixties, everyone had rediscovered Marx (which later would lead to scientific socialism, as a term that "implied not a complete surrender" to western ideology). The realness of this phenomenon cannot be ignored... the gradual adaptation of western informational dynamics by the so-called black revolutionaries cannot be simply dismissed as normal within the multi-informational state of things (source transfer).' The crossing diagrams how world-exposure-principle structurally meets information-dynamics at the sixties-end Marxism-adoption scale: WO-EXP-PRI (world-exposure principle — the principle by which a form's world-exposure is supposed to work) crossed with INFO-DY (information dynamics — the form's actual information output). WO-EXP-PRI sits on the right with the subject-arrow; INFO-DY sits at top-center as partner-axis. INFO-TRNS (information-transition) at upper-left, with T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) hanging below on the lower-left as the partner-side downward chain. DOC (documentation) sits centrally with SPT-DY (spectacle dynamics) below as the bridging-axis downward output. IF-ST-DY (isolated-focus stable-dynamics) sits at upper-right with MT-INTR (meta-introduction) on the right, POST (postulation) at lower-right, and AF-DY (affinity dynamics) at the bottom-right as the subject-side downward chain. Structural argument: when world-exposure-principle is crossed with information-dynamics, the upper diagonal INFO-DY → INFO-TRNS → T-C-IMP → PROG-CONT is the *source-transfer route* — information-dynamics routes through information-transition into temporal-continuity-implication and finally into progressional-continuance on the partner-side. This is structurally exactly the Marx-adoption mechanism the prose names: the upper diagonal supplies progressional-continuance via the form's *partner-axis*'s working — the activists' progressional-continuance comes from the partner-axis's western informational chain, not from world-exposure-principle's own working. DOC → SPT-DY on the central bridging chain is what world-exposure-principle and information-dynamics produce together when held — documentation into spectacle-dynamics. IF-ST-DY → MT-INTR → POST → AF-DY on the subject side is what world-exposure produces on its own without the partner's upper chain — isolated-focus stable-dynamics routes through meta-introduction into postulation and finally into affinity-dynamics. The structural argument: the sixties black revolutionaries' adoption of Marxism is the case where INFO-DY's upper diagonal supplies PROG-CONT via the western chain while WO-EXP-PRI's subject-side AF-DY chain remains active but unrouted to the partner-axis — the multi-informational state of things the prose names is structurally this: two complete chains running in parallel without crossing.
